## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sree Jayam Dental Clinic?
Ground Floor, Sri Vinayaga Flats, Voltas Colony Ext, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061.

### What facilities does Sree Jayam Dental Clinic have?
Orthodontics & Invisalign, Root canal treatment, Dental implants, Full mouth reconstruction, Gum care, Crowns & bridges, Dentures, Cosmetic dentistry, Teeth whitening, Veneers, Child dentistry, Mouth guards, Free consultation 8–9 AM.

### Is there a free consultation?
Yes. A free dental consultation is available every day from 8:00 to 9:00 AM.

### What are the clinic timings?
Monday to Saturday, 8 AM – 12:30 PM and 5:30 – 9 PM. Sunday by appointment only.

### How do I book an appointment at Sree Jayam Dental Clinic?
